new_value: Fixed in commit 2f2010b3f0: rekey now purges _previous entries with created_s + GRACE_PERIOD_S < now (strict boundary consistent with key_valid_at), so superseded key material is no longer retained indefinitely; dropped bytearray key buffers are zeroized in place (bytes documented as unscrubbable), including collision-dropped wrap entries. GroupKeyMaterial.key widened to bytes|bytearray for the zeroization path. Test: TestPreviousRetention pins that after grace elapses on the injected clock _previous no longer holds the old material (key_for_epoch(1) is None) and that a dropped bytearray key is overwritten with zeros.
